name: git-workflow
description: A repository workflow toolkit with detached PR and issue desks whose explicit actions run visible, ephemeral agents.

interface.shortDescription: Drain pull request and issue queues safely.
interface.longDescription: Serve pull requests and issues from local/provider JSON, explicitly triage them with fingerprinted verdicts, and show sanitized live progress from agent processes started only for requested analyses or approved work.
defaultPrompt: Use $pr-triage to show what needs my attention.
Use $git-desk to open the pull request and issue desk.
